response.note: Assumes 'last week' is the previous Monday-Sunday week (2026-10-19 to 2026-10-25) and that a successful attempt has status = 'SUCCESS'; technical success rate is computed over all attempts.
response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_attempts, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_attempts, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS technical_success_rate_pct FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-19' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-26' LIMIT 50
